outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the door, then raises it toward the oven body (frames 71–103, image and left_ego_image). By frame 104 the door is upright against the oven front, and it remains closed through frame 174 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visibly established.
